assertions.name: text_under_800_chars
assertions.description: Visible text (tags stripped) is under 800 characters

assertions.name: min_4_svg_visuals
assertions.description: At least 4 SVG elements with data content (not just bg patterns)

assertions.name: no_text_align_left
assertions.description: Zero instances of text-align:left in the HTML

assertions.name: has_text_align_center
assertions.description: At least one text-align:center in the HTML

assertions.name: validator_passes
assertions.description: python -m src.validate passes with exit code 0

assertions.name: correct_dimensions
assertions.description: HTML contains 1920 and 1080 for proper sizing
